metrics_explanation.precision: Proportion of detected potholes that were actually potholes (True Positives / (True Positives + False Positives)).
metrics_explanation.recall: Proportion of all true road potholes that were successfully detected (True Positives / (True Positives + False Negatives)).
metrics_explanation.f1_score: Harmonic mean of precision and recall balancing detection accuracy and coverage.
metrics_explanation.mAP50: Mean Average Precision at IoU threshold 0.50 - standard object detection accuracy benchmark.
metrics_explanation.mAP50_95: Mean Average Precision averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95 in steps of 0.05 - rigorous localization benchmark.
metrics_explanation.classification_vs_detection_note: In classification, accuracy simply measures whether an entire image was categorized correctly. In object detection, accuracy depends on localization (predicting precise bounding box coordinates with high Intersection-over-Union) as well as correct class identification. mAP is the gold-standard academic metric.
